title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B
abstract: arXiv:2608.22975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embodied multimodal agents must answer from growing observation streams under a fixed per-decision token budget. We formalize this constraint through four resource walls: a perceptual Shannon wall for bounded state, a horizon wall for query-independent frame selection, a round wall for non-adaptive retrieval, and a conditional composition wall for fixed-depth inference. We introduce ASP, a training-free wrapper for frozen multimodal models that combines a capped structured state, a verbatim episodic index, and query-conditioned budget allocation with iterative access. Following a pre-registered protocol, we evaluate seven open-weight models from 3B to 31B on SEW-Bench, a license-free synthetic long-horizon walkthrough benchmark constructed to instantiate these walls. The registered natural-video benchmarks were not run because their frames require dataset agreements; our evidence therefore concerns access mechanisms, not natural-scene pe

translated_title: 预算受限的具身感知：四重资源墙及对小于31B开放模型上访问结构感知的预注册评估
translated_abstract: 具身多模态代理必须在固定的每次决策令牌预算下，从不断增长的观察流中做出回答。我们通过四重资源墙来形式化这一约束：用于有界状态的感知香农墙、用于与查询无关的帧选择的视界墙、用于非自适应检索的轮次墙，以及用于固定深度推理的条件组合墙。我们引入了ASP，一种无需训练的包装器，用于冻结的多模态模型，它结合了封顶的结构化状态、逐字情节索引，以及带有迭代访问的查询条件预算分配。遵循预注册协议，我们在SEW-Bench上评估了从3B到31B的七个开放权重模型，SEW-Bench是一个无许可的合成长视野漫游基准，专门构建以实例化这些墙。注册的自然视频基准未运行，因为其帧需要数据集协议；因此，我们的证据涉及访问机制，而非自然场景感知。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的访问结构感知包装器ASP，通过四重资源墙框架和预注册评估，在开放模型上有效应对固定令牌预算下的具身感知挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ASP, a training-free access-structured perception wrapper, using a four-resource-wall framework and pre-registered evaluations to tackle embodied perception under fixed token budgets on open models.
